name: updateCategoriesAdvanced
description: Changes several categories at once, up to 50.

categories.description: The categories to change and what changes for each, up to 50 at a time.

categoryId.description: The category's id, as shown in search results.

newTitle.description: The category's new title. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newIcon.description: The new icon picture, as a list holding one image; it replaces any library icon. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newIconClassName.description: The name of a library icon to show instead of a picture. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

callback.description: Runs when all the categories are done.

error.description: Why nothing was changed, such as an unknown category id.

categories.description: One result per category, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which category this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The category's id, if it was changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, if it wasn't.
